title: Jtube's Easter Egg Hunt
description: Easter-ify your world! Changes eggs to look like Easter Eggs and Bundles to look like Easter baskets! Perfect for hosting a easter egg hunt with your friends!
body: Easter is here! This pack Easter-ifies your world! It'll change eggs to look like Easter eggs and turn bundles into Easter Baskets! Perfect to host Easter egg hunts with your friends! Happy Eastering!
